script.problem: It has 2 sentences. Explanations are 3 to 5 sentences.

terra.problem: “Right after” makes the preceding scene immediately precede the trip, but Luke says only “in those days.”
The reference to people filled with rage is a fact from outside this passage and needs a reference to Luke 6:11.
The claim that mountains and fasting appear together in a lot of stories is unsupported.
The claim about prophets as a Bible title points outside the passage without a reference.
The claim about elders elsewhere in Scripture needs a reference.
“I see how it slipped in” assumes the baker chose Silas because it starts with S.
“I'll just say it plainly and let it sit” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
“Close to the end of the list” doesn't make sense as an explanation of the tax collector answer.
“I'll keep it simple and let the verse speak” comments on how Papa tells the passage.
“They got both” says the crowd heard Jesus as well as being healed. This passage says they came to hear Him, but does not say they heard Him.
The account of leaders talking among themselves comes from outside the passage and needs a reference to Luke 6:11.
“Nobody who came was turned away” adds a detail the passage does not state.
